# Warrior One Pose - Form Correction

Great effort today! I can see you're working hard, and I want to help you refine a few things to get the most out of this powerful pose. Let me walk you through some adjustments.

---

## 🔸 Spine Alignment

First, I want you to focus on your spine. Right now it's rounding forward a little. I want you to imagine there's a straight line running from the crown of your head all the way down through your tailbone. **Engage your core gently, lengthen upward, and think about standing tall and proud.** A straight spine will deepen the stretch and protect your lower back beautifully.

---

## 🔸 Arms Position

Now let's talk about your arms. They're dropping slightly rather than reaching fully upward. **Push your palms toward the ceiling with intention** - really extend through your fingertips. Think of your arms as an extension of your spine, reaching for the sky. You'll immediately feel the pose open up through your chest and shoulders.

---

## 🔸 Knee Over Ankle

Finally, check your front knee. It's drifting out of alignment with your ankle. **Gently shift it so it's stacking directly over your ankle.** This protects your knee joint and gives you a much stronger, more stable foundation.

---

You're doing wonderfully - these small adjustments will make a **huge** difference! Let's try again! 💪
